title: Microsoft Copilot Studio: Persistent identity for Copilot Studio Agents
description: Makers can now give their Copilot Studio agents their own accounts, making it a governed Microsoft 365 identity for shared, collaborative business processes that spans across teams. With its own mailbox, Teams presence & Office access, the agent can collaborate where work happens while admins can control and govern its access, policies and use as its own first-class entity.
